description: P3-D0b step 0 hand-built door references. Polygons drawn by eye on one live snapshot per Frigate camera (HA camera_proxy of the registry-resolved Frigate camera entity, platform frigate, client_id frigate-f2), normalised x,y in [0,1] from top-left, FROZEN before any human label was scored against an instrument. in = track ends at the door polygon (padded) and did not start there; out = starts there and does not end there.

madrone_g6_entry.note: glass front door at right edge, mat at bottom right

front_door_aerial.note: overhead view, door threshold along the bottom edge below the mat

garage_a.note: interior overhead view, the garage door across the top

doorbell_lite.note: exterior view, garage door face down the right side

door_contacts._rule: Mapped by registry area: the contact or cover whose area equals the door group's cameras' area (entity registry area_id, else device area_id) and device_class door/garage/opening.

front.why: never reported on (open) in the recorder window

not_mapped_by_registry.binary_sensor.elkm1_front_door: platform elkm1, 128 on/off rows, but registry area is AV Closet (hub device), so it cannot be tied to the Front Porch by registry; reported as an operator question only
not_mapped_by_registry.binary_sensor.doorlock_kwikset_zwave_fro: area Entry Way; only state on in the window
